messages:
Nina: FYI - I found a ~$52,400 discrepancy between prepaid dedicated invoices and the revenue recognition schedule for Mar close. Looks concentrated in two customer lines.

Leo: Can you drop the invoice ids + what the schedule shows vs billed?

Nina: From payments export: 
INV-2026-1588, customer: Orbit, billed: 2026-02-20, amount: 120000, term_months: 12, expected_monthly: 10000
INV-2026-1623, customer: Nimbus, billed: 2026-03-06, amount: 42000, term_months: 6, expected_monthly: 7000
But schedule shows Nimbus at 6000/month (1k short x6=6k) and there's an adjustment JE for -46,400 posted on 2026-03-12 labeled misc_realloc by user revenue_bot -> total ~52.4k.

Aria: Who posted misc_realloc? any ticket or note?

Nina: Billing tags show user revenue_bot. I pulled the script log and ticket REF-3917 references a promo credit migration. Link: https://redwood-internal.sheets/s/recon-march

Tom: That's from the migration job that rewrites old prepaid splits when promos were applied. It sometimes writes a manual allocation when net_of_promos wasn't handled.

Rohit: For the close we need: 1) a reconciliation sheet (invoice_id, billed_amount, schedule_amount, delta, schedule_id), 2) proposed JE with GL accounts, 3) approver sign-off. Can this be ready by 1pm PT?

Nina: I'll compile the CSV and flag lines where schedule != expected. Sample row I'll add: 
INV-2026-1623,Nimbus,2026-03,expected_monthly=7000,on_schedule=6000,delta=1000

Tom: Proposed correcting JE to reverse the erroneous allocation: 
DR Deferred Revenue (GL 2102) 52,400
CR Revenue Reclassification (GL 2190) 52,400
This reclass will restore deferred balances to expected amounts.

Leo: Please attach invoice PDFs, billing export, and the migration script log lines for each affected invoice. Also state whether we should book this in March or spread forward.

Rohit: Recommend book as a one-time adjustment in March close to avoid pulling future periods.

Nina: Uploaded attachments to the recon sheet and pinned the rows. Tagged @Rohit.

Rohit: Reviewing now. If backup matches, I'll approve the JE. Also ask Tom to open a PR to fix the migration logic (ticket REF-3917).

Tom: I'll pause the migration for affected customers and include a unit test for promo netting. Will post PR link to the ticket.

Leo: Approved contingent on attachments and JE mapping to GLs. :white_check_mark:

Rohit: Approved. I'll post JE number after posting in our ledger and then update the revenue schedule.

Nina: Closing - JE posted in March; schedules updated and recon finalized. Will follow up with RCA summary on the migration edge case.

Tom: RCA will cover root cause (promo amount excluded from net_of_promos flag) and remediation (script fix + added test + deployment checklist).
